review.finding: The F11 gate _build calls configured_test_roots on a throwaway temp archive, so the per-root dedup never matches, the line names a deleted temp dir and 'no test file will be scanned' can be false because _build adds defaults and extra roots.
review.suggestion: Warn only from generate_file (real project root); keep the gate silent and rely on no_scan_note.

review.finding: A test whose only tag is malformed lands in invalid_tags, so the note wrongly fires.
The '(or none carries an @FR tag)' wording never applies in the gate path because untagged tests are enumerated.
review.suggestion: Reword to 'no test file was found in the scanned folders'.

review.finding: _warn_no_roots reads the config twice (unreadable-config line twice) and warns on an explicit empty test_roots list which is a deliberate opt-out.
review.suggestion: Read once; stay silent for an explicit empty list.

review.finding: count >= 2 is looser than one line per root.
The wiring in check_cross_layer_coverage is untested.

notes: Spec scope matches; sizes under cap; no config echo.
